design.heldout_calibration: null calibration, null evaluation, and alternative streams use distinct SHA-derived seeds
design.marginal_dispersion_role: single predeclared first-cell negative control because both hypotheses have exactly the same one-cell Poisson law

deterministic_manifest.scenario_seed_derivation: little-endian uint32 from SHA-256 design coordinate prefix

gpu_cpu_crosscheck.scope: exact-formula sentinel plus CPU recomputation of bounded slices from every GPU dataset and PGF panel

interpretation.implementation_stress: fused batched CUDA PGF/Laplace projections and joint-moment reductions
interpretation.non_test: does not validate transactions, ontology, the paper, QED, an action-derived point process, or real-event correspondence
interpretation.synthetic_falsification_power: ability to distinguish independent increments from a declared marginal-preserving correlated alternative

runtime_measurement.scope: device-wide nonexclusive counters; unique count generation and effective non-padding PGF/projection evaluations are reported separately

utilization.counter_scope: device-wide NVML samples during synchronized kernels; may include concurrent processes and are not a lane-only or sustained-capacity claim

set_indexed_contract.alternative: block-Poisson common shocks preserve every one-cell Poisson marginal but violate disjoint-cell independence
set_indexed_contract.null: independent Poisson counts on every declared disjoint cell
